Let
\[
M_3=\begin{pmatrix}
1&r&s\\
r&1&r\\
s&r&1
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
The hypotheses imply
\[
1-r^2>0,\qquad (1-r^2)^2-(s-r^2)^2>0,
\]
so the prescribed \(3\times 3\) principal Toeplitz block is positive definite.

For any admissible \(T\), view \(T\) as the covariance matrix of centered real random variables
\[
X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}.
\]
Then
\[
\det T=\prod_{j=0}^{n-1}\operatorname{Var}(X_j\mid X_0,\dots,X_{j-1}),
\]
with the \(j=0\) factor equal to \(\operatorname{Var}(X_0)=1\). This is just the repeated Schur complement formula.

The first two factors are fixed:
\[
\operatorname{Var}(X_0)=1,\qquad
\operatorname{Var}(X_1\mid X_0)=1-r^2.
\]
For every \(j\ge2\), conditioning on more variables cannot increase variance, hence
\[
\operatorname{Var}(X_j\mid X_0,\dots,X_{j-1})
\le
\operatorname{Var}(X_j\mid X_{j-1},X_{j-2}).
\]
By the Toeplitz condition, the covariance matrix of \((X_j,X_{j-1},X_{j-2})\) is always \(M_3\). Therefore
\[
\operatorname{Var}(X_j\mid X_{j-1},X_{j-2})
=
\frac{\det M_3}{\det\begin{pmatrix}1&r\\ r&1\end{pmatrix}}
=
\frac{(1-r^2)^2-(s-r^2)^2}{1-r^2}.
\]
Thus
\[
\det T\le
(1-r^2)\left(\frac{(1-r^2)^2-(s-r^2)^2}{1-r^2}\right)^{n-2}.
\]

It remains to show equality is attainable. Define
\[
a=\frac{r(1-s)}{1-r^2},\qquad
b=\frac{s-r^2}{1-r^2},\qquad
q=\frac{(1-r^2)^2-(s-r^2)^2}{1-r^2}.
\]
Take centered Gaussian \(X_0,X_1\) with covariance matrix
\[
\begin{pmatrix}1&r\\ r&1\end{pmatrix},
\]
and for \(j\ge2\) set
\[
X_j=aX_{j-1}+bX_{j-2}+\varepsilon_j,
\]
where the \(\varepsilon_j\) are independent centered Gaussians of variance \(q\), independent of \(X_0,X_1\).

The choices of \(a,b,q\) give
\[
\operatorname{Var}(X_j)=1,\qquad
\operatorname{Cov}(X_j,X_{j-1})=r,\qquad
\operatorname{Cov}(X_j,X_{j-2})=s,
\]
and by induction the covariance matrix is Toeplitz. Since \(q>0\), it is positive definite. Also
\[
\operatorname{Var}(X_j\mid X_0,\dots,X_{j-1})=q
\]
for every \(j\ge2\), so equality holds in the upper bound.

Therefore the largest possible determinant is
\[
\boxed{\frac{\left((1-r^2)^2-(s-r^2)^2\right)^{\,n-2}}{(1-r^2)^{\,n-3}}}.
\]
